Capture any success, warning, or refusal toast produced by the first submission.

args.goal: If the Recreate Order window closed, reopen it from the RFQ stage Settings menu; select Custom under Evaluation Duration, enter exactly 500 characters consisting only of A in the field with placeholder 10, click Create Order, and record the resulting field error, refusal or success message and whether the window remains open.

steps.note: The catalog cannot express the conditional reopen and exact long-input outcome recording in one deterministic sequence, so perform this second case adaptively on the buyer screen.
